mapper.select: select * from employee e join tb_user u on e.user_no=u.user_no left outer join file_group f on f.file_group_no = u.user_profile left outer join file_detail fd on f.file_group_no=fd.file_group_no

select * from employee e join tb_user u on e.user_no=u.user_no join position p on e.position_no= p.position_no join dept d on e.dept_no=d.dept_no left outer join file_group f on f.file_group_no = u.user_profile left outer join file_detail fd on f.file_group_no=fd.file_group_no where 1=1 and e.user_no!= #{userNo}
and user_nm like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT CHAT_SEND_NO, CHAT_ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, CHAT_SEND_CONTENT, c.FILE_GROUP_NO, CHAT_SEND_DATE, CHAT_SEND_DEL, RECEIVER_NO, user_nm, fd.file_save_locate,fd.file_original_name FROM CHAT_SEND c left outer join tb_user u on c.SENDER_NO=u.user_no left outer join file_group f on f.file_group_no=c.file_group_no left outer join file_detail fd on fd.file_group_no= f.file_group_no WHERE (SENDER_NO = #{senderNo} OR RECEIVER_NO = #{senderNo}) AND (SENDER_NO = #{receiverNo} OR RECEIVER_NO = #{receiverNo}) ORDER BY CHAT_SEND_NO ASC
